messages:
maria: Noticed ~6% drop in prefix cache hit rate after the system-prompt tweak yesterday. Spike in unique keys/min.
jamal: Confirmed on the perf dashboard — p95 for 512-token gen up ~12%. Snapshot shows many near-duplicates differing only by whitespace or key ordering.
li: I pulled a sample. Before: `user:123|prompt:Order pizza`
After template change: `user:123 | prompt: Order pizza\n` — trailing newline + space.
maria: Also seeing tool call fields serialized differently across SDK versions. Example key fragments: `{\"name\":\"get_menu\",\"args\":{...}}` -> `{\"args\":{...},\"name\":\"get_menu\"}`
ops-bot: deploy-bot: canary rolled to 10% at 11:34 UTC :rocket:
jamal: Proposal: introduce a canonical keying step: trim/collapse whitespace, strip trailing newlines, normalize Unicode (NFC), and canonicalize JSON tool fields (sorted keys). Also include tokenizer_fingerprint in key metadata.
li: Agreed but note tradeoffs: canonicalization fixes most misses but we must be explicit about invalidation semantics. If system prompt changes semantically, we should bump a cache_version to avoid stale hits.
maria: Warmup ideas: 1) Offline job to precompute top-1k prefixes from last 24h and seed the KV cache; 2) Low-priority background warmers that replay heavy prefixes; 3) Sticky routing to keep warmed shards hot during canary.
jamal: Ran a local sim with canonicalization + JSON sort: hit rate +18% on sampled traffic, p95 down ~9%. Need a controlled canary to validate in prod (false positives possible if canonicalization merges legitimately different prompts).
li: Also adding metric proposal: key_entropy_per_min and unique_key_delta to alert on sudden key explosion (could indicate a bug or drift in templates).
maria: Rollout plan: patch runtime keygen with feature flag -> canary 5% (no cache_version bump) -> monitor hit rate & key_entropy for 6h -> if stable, enable warmup job and increase to 50% -> if system-prompt changed, then bump cache_version and run full warmup.
jamal: I'll add a canary dashboard tile and an alert when hit_rate < baseline -10% or key_entropy increases > 2x. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: incident-bot: note added to postmortem queue if canary hit-rate falls below baseline -10% for 30m.
li: I'll draft the key canonicalization helper (small, deterministic, zero-deps) and drop a patch by EOD. Maria — want to own rollout? 
maria: I can own rollout + warmup job. Thanks, team.
